x: Linstead)----Len Duquemin (5) and John Moullins,our new members from Guernsey, seen during our Open '7'.

Our new twins Len Duquemin and John Moullins were inseparable and, in their first Bels "Open", both scored. Bob Barnes was not in the form that placed him 9th last year but his 24th position was still good enough to close-in our scorers.
Len Duquemin and John Moullins were, once again, the core of the team and whipping them all in was our captain Pat Duncan who, for the second successive week was in amongst the Mexicans.
